content:
If sentiment is positive (≥0.5) in the last 3 days, increase forecast by 0.5–1.5% for early horizon (1–7 days) to capture bullish momentum.

If sentiment is negative (≤-0.5) in the last 3 days, reduce forecast by 0.5–1.5% for early horizon (1–7 days) to hedge downside risk.

If sentiment is neutral (0.0–0.5) and price is trending upward, add 1–2% to mid-horizon (8–15 days) forecast to reflect momentum continuation.

If sentiment is neutral and price is trending downward, subtract 1–2% from mid-horizon (8–15 days) forecast to reflect bearish continuation.

If sentiment turns positive after a negative streak (e.g., -0.3 to +0.5), add 1–3% to late-horizon (16–30 days) forecast to capture reversal momentum.

If sentiment turns negative after a positive streak (e.g., +0.3 to -0.5), subtract 1–3% from late-horizon (16–30 days) forecast to reflect reversal risk.
